Architectural Blueprints & Mathematical Schematics

Explore each algorithm's internal mechanical representation, mathematical formulations, and operational roles

🌊

1. Wavelet-KAN (Kolmogorov-Arnold Network)

Continuous Wavelet Splines

Unlike traditional Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) that place static activation functions on nodes, Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks place learnable non-linear continuous functions directly on the network edges. We equip each edge with Morlet wavelets combined with SiLU B-splines.

Mathematical Formula:
$$\Phi(x) = \sum_{q=1}^{2n+1} \Phi_q\left(\sum_{p=1}^n \phi_{q,p}(x_p) ight)$$ $$\phi(x) = w_b ext{SiLU}(x) + w_w \cos(\omega x) e^{- rac{1}{2} x^2}$$
Advantage: Completely eliminates catastrophic forgetting while capturing localized multi-frequency market turbulence.
🔄

2. 3-State Gaussian Hidden Markov Model

Regime Switching

Markets transition between distinct unobservable macroeconomic states. The 3-State Gaussian HMM decodes the latent regime probability distribution today using the forward-backward Baum-Welch algorithm.

State Transition Probability:
$$P(S_t = j \mid S_{t-1} = i) = A_{ij}$$ $$R_t \mid S_t \sim \mathcal{N}(\mu_{S_t}, \sigma^2_{S_t})$$
Advantage: Prevents premature entries in choppy markets and dynamically recalibrates volatility bands based on current posterior regime probabilities.
🎯

3. Dual-Stage Temporal & Feature Attention

Transformer Self-Attention

Uses Query-Key-Value self-attention to dynamically focus computational weight on the most predictive subset of the 28 multi-modal inputs, as well as weighting historical quarterly temporal anchors ($t-30, t-60, t-90, t-252$).

Attention Mechanism:
$$lpha_i = ext{Softmax}\left( rac{\mathbf{q}_i \mathbf{k}_i^ op}{\sqrt{d}} ight), \quad \hat{\mathbf{z}} = \sum_{i=1}^{28} lpha_i \mathbf{v}_i$$
Advantage: Identifies non-linear cross-talk between YouTube attention surges and real-time energy consumption spikes.
⚛️

4. Physics-Informed Jump-Diffusion (PINN / SDE)

Stochastic Calculus

Enforces physical laws of market dynamics: prices exhibit Ornstein-Uhlenbeck mean-reversion towards intrinsic economic valuation, combined with discrete Poisson jump events at quarterly earnings announcements.

Stochastic Differential Equation:
$$dS_t = \kappa (ar{S} - S_t) dt + \sigma S_t dW_t + J_t dN_t$$
Advantage: Prevents runaway exponential price hallucinations and naturally simulates earnings volatility shocks at Days 38, 98, 162, and 226.
🌟

5. Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO Ensemble)

Swarm Meta-Learner

Rather than using a fixed naive average, a swarm of 20 computational agents traverses the multi-dimensional parameter space to find the asset-specific optimal weights $w_i^*$ that minimize out-of-sample forecast variance while maximizing Sharpe ratio.

Swarm Velocity & Position Updates:
$$\mathbf{v}_i^{(k+1)} = \omega \mathbf{v}_i^{(k)} + c_1 r_1 (\mathbf{p}_i^{ ext{best}} - \mathbf{x}_i^{(k)}) + c_2 r_2 (\mathbf{g}^{ ext{best}} - \mathbf{x}_i^{(k)})$$ $$\hat{P}_{ ext{consensus}} = \sum_{m=1}^{6} w_m^* \hat{P}_m, \quad \sum w_m^* = 1.0$$
Advantage: Consistently outperforms any individual isolated model by dampening idiosyncratic model error spikes.
🧠

6. 10x Deep ResNet-128 Engine

Residual CNN

Features 144,259 trainable parameters across 4 residual blocks with identity skip connections $\mathbf{y} = \mathbf{x} + \mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x})$, layer normalization, and dedicated 30D, 60D, 90D multi-horizon forecast heads.

Residual Skip Formulation:
$$\mathbf{y}_l = \mathbf{x}_l + \mathbf{W}_2 \cdot ext{LeakyReLU}\left( ext{LayerNorm}(\mathbf{W}_1 \mathbf{x}_l + \mathbf{b}_1) ight) + \mathbf{b}_2$$
Advantage: Preserves high-frequency gradient flow and captures deep abstract representations across all 28 multi-modal inputs.

1. Cyclical Reality (1-Year Lookback)

One year ago, IIIN was at $38. The decline to $24 was structural. The bounce to $30 is a cyclical dead-cat bounce, not a new secular bull market.

2. Leading Industrial Energy Demand Vector

Federal Reserve industrial production and building materials kilowatt-hour draw (moving 30-60d ahead of the curve) show weakening commercial demand.
